name: konoha
description: A squad of Konoha ninja (reusable subagents) that power five dev-workflow skills: /scroll (draft a Linear issue), /mission (ticket to Draft PR), /debrief (resolve the reviews on your PR), /exam (review a colleague's PR), and /seal (seal an existing PR with the PR creation workflow fingerprint). From 0.3.0 to 0.10.0 Codex (newest GPT) was the decision maker — it authored the plan and ruled on contested findings — and Claude executed; since 0.11.0 Claude plans again and Codex keeps the review close and the rulings. 0.4.0 added Kurenai, the illusion-dispel AI-output lens (hallucinated APIs + slop); 0.5.0 added two-dial mission tiering (difficulty × risk), the ANBU failure-path lens, and the delta close; 0.6.0 makes /exam verify every finding against the merge base and classify it by provenance, so a review carries only what the PR introduced — pre-existing and codebase-wide findings are handed back as a separate follow-up list instead of growing the diff. 0.7.0 strips the /exam review down to findings only — no opening take and no "checked and clean" list, so it opens on the first problem; every check still runs, but only a check that failed is reported. 0.7.0 strips the review of its preamble and its clean list — it opens on the first problem and never reports a passing check — gives /exam its own worktree step, and caps /mission at two planned prompts (APP_ENV target, ship confirmation) without muting failure-path stops. 0.8.0 makes PR images the user's alone: scripts/pr-body.sh guards every PR body edit (Naruto edit-pr, and a check before open-pr) — the live body is the reference, every image reference is carried verbatim in its slot, none is added, and a removed one is never restored. 0.9.0 lets /mission take a Linear issue link or identifier as well as a GitHub issue: Kakashi reads the ticket, its comments, relations and images over the linear-server MCP in the main loop (fail closed when it is not connected), hands Itachi a ticket file, names the branch after the lowercased identifier, and the PR body ends with Closes <KEY>-<n> — <url> so Linear's GitHub integration links it; the worktree and the Draft PR now base on development instead of staging. Inspired by thk, but where thk has one entrypoint, konoha shares one cast across five skills. Naruto-themed skin over a neutral engine. 0.10.0 brings the org's workflows in and runs Codex at full strength: the shared _pr-creation module runs the tplus-services PR creation workflow (docs/process/pr-creation.md) inside /mission and in the new /seal — the user writes the description, Kakashi interviews her about what it leaves out, keeps her words verbatim, and ends the body with the fingerprint the auditor's test-requirements check reads; /scroll follows the issue-creation workflow (at least five interview rounds, one background research pass, Summary / Context and evidence / Scope / Verification, a fresh-context review, one approval) and creates the issue in Linear team FE over the linear-server MCP instead of GitHub; scripts/codex-common.sh puts Gaara and the architect on the newest gpt-*-sol the Codex CLI lists at the reasoning effort of the user's codex config, exits 5 on an empty final message, and appends every run to ~/.konoha/codex-runs.jsonl. 0.11.0 gives the plan back to Claude, as before 0.3.0: Shikamaru writes plan.md again in the 0.3 decision-record shape and revises it for a design deviation or an answered open question; the Codex architect's plan mode and Shikamaru's plan review are retired, and architect-codex.sh becomes arbiter-codex.sh, which only rules on declined findings — a decline still needs its GRANTED ruling.
